This method derives each sample network from all-sample and leave-one-out networks, which can provide insights into how individual samples contribute to the overall network structure. This is particularly useful in understanding gene connections under specific conditions like heat stress, as it can highlight sample-specific variations in gene expression. The method requires an expression file and outputs sample-specific co-expression networks, which aligns with your need to see how genes are connected in your experiment.
